scope: Data-distribution decisions and sign-off evidence for the public release. Records evidence only; it is not a legal grant and does not change any frozen Task file, workload, expected output, gate or timing rule. Validate with: python3 -m tools.public_release_ledger

policy.heldout: Held-out sets are released (owner decision, docs/heldout-lfs.md). Fetch-only held-out inputs ship as pinned URL + SHA-256 recipes, never as rehosted bodies.

image_policies.ecr-after-signoff: Image may be pushed to public ECR once every item is verified and the release checks pass.
image_policies.build-locally: Image must not be pushed to a public registry; users build it from environment/Dockerfile, which fetches inputs from their upstreams. The source repository may still be public.
image_policies.held: Excluded from this release round; resolve the reason first.

statuses.verified: Checked against the cited evidence. approved_by records a team decision where one was made.
statuses.requires-human-judgment: A permission or usage question that only a responsible person can decide; it blocks the Task until decided.

release_scope.note: Fourteen candidate Tasks. A Task is release-ready only when every item is verified; an unresolved permission question stays a blocker. NumPy and SQLite are required; their units built from a non-redistributable source were removed on 2026-11-17.

release_checks.evidence: Allowlist = every tracked path of the release commit (52,999 paths); the six serde_json held-out expected bodies are not tracked; no held Task is present; 0 omissions.

release_checks.item: Inspect the final one-commit Git/LFS export against the allowlist
release_checks.evidence: One root commit with no history; tree identical to the release commit (0 extra, missing or mismatched paths); every LFS pointer valid and referenced; content scans found no TPC query text, no data from removed third-party sources, no Timescale tsl/ files, no secrets and no personal email addresses in our files. The fresh LFS store holds exactly the 47,035 referenced objects, confirmed by the GitHub LFS batch API.

release_checks.item: Inspect every layer of each image intended for public ECR; never publish intermediate build stages or input-holding caches
release_checks.evidence: All 14 pushed images audited layer by layer: recipe label equals the committed recipe; input-free images carry no input body in any layer; no removed or forbidden path (TPC fixtures, benchmarks/parse.py, Gutenberg batch, bike-share builder, Highmaps/webticker/p5play/cryptico, tsl/, credentials) in any layer; licence notices present. A negative test confirmed the audit detects TPC fixtures in the superseded SQLGlot image. Superseded untagged images were deleted from the registry.

release_checks.item: Per Task on Linux x86-64 from the exported snapshot: credential-free setup, clean image build, baseline passes, negative control rejected; record commit IDs and image digests
release_checks.evidence: Each image was built on a fresh Linux x86-64 VM from a clone of the release branch with the recipe label, and each build replays its baseline against every public expected output. Judge gates (--gates-only, public) on the exact pushed digest of every Task: the pristine baseline passed and a deliberately corrupted source was rejected, for all 14 Tasks. Image digests are pinned in each task.toml.

release_checks.item: v1.0 timing qualification and a positive-gain control; ledger validation and unit tests are not benchmark qualification
release_checks.evidence: Not part of the v1.0 release gate: timing qualification and a positive-gain control are planned after release. Correctness, gates and image audits above are complete.
